question: What additional element accompanies the four Śiva-seed-syllables in this mantra formation?
premises: A group of four Śiva-seed-syllables is taken.
The ra is endowed with anugraha and visarga.
inference: The formation includes four Śiva-bījas together with repha bearing anugraha and visarga.
uncertainties: The technical meaning of anugraha in this phonetic context is not explicit.
plain_english: Take a group of four Śiva-seed-syllables and add repha endowed with anugraha and visarga.
